Issue Number: close #57859

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

separate the nested logic of table rewriting and building id map.
For building id map we only need to look at the default cf and only for db entry and table entry, rewrite does much more than that, so separating will make code looks cleaner and easier to do table filtering later.

issue_context.title: br: separate build id map and rewrite logic
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Right now these two functions are interleaved together to reuse some part of the code. The build id map logic can actually be simplified to its own file and the overall code complexity should reduce.

review_comments: Do we need to make sure that the `tableInfo-kv` does not have short value in write cf value?
you are right, missed that, adding now!

here and similar places below only filtered out table/db will not be able to find the mapping so just returning nothing. Right now filtered out tables are only some system table. 
Might need some safer mechanism to check if indeed they are filtered out tables, not a valid table but we missed due to error in the building id map phase .
